div.div:
Enums (voorstel)
Role: ADMIN, BUYER, PRINTZ, DHL, HONG KONG
OrderStatus: PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED
ItemStatus: RECEIVED, BLANK_RECEIVED, PRINTING, PRINTED, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, FAILED
ProductStatus: AVAILABLE, OUT_OF_STOCK, DISCONTINUED
ShipmentType: TO Warehouse ,TO_PRINTZ, TO_CUSTOMER
ShipmentStatus: CREATED, IN_TRANSIT, DELIVERED, DELAYED, FAILED
ImportStatus: ORDERED, IN_TRANSIT, STUCK_IN_CUSTOMS, RECEIVED
CustomerType: B2B, B2C
ExceptionType: CUSTOMS_DELAY, OUT_OF_STOCK, PRINT_FAILURE, CAPACITY_SHORTAGE, ADDRESS_PROBLEM, FAILED_DELIVERY
Urgency: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL
ExceptionStatus: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, ESCALATED, RESOLVED
Grijze velden (Order[], Item[] ...) zijn Prisma relatievelden, geen kolommen in de database.
